mapper.select: SELECT g.id AS goalId, g.total_budget AS targetAmount, g.groom_ratio AS groomRatio, g.bride_ratio AS brideRatio, g.created_at AS createdAt FROM goal g WHERE g.couple_id = #{coupleId} AND g.is_main = TRUE AND g.status = 'CONFIRMED' ORDER BY g.created_at DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT gi.id AS goalItemId, gi.category AS category, gi.target_amount AS targetAmount, gi.is_completed AS completed FROM goal_item gi WHERE gi.goal_id = #{goalId} AND gi.is_included = TRUE ORDER BY gi.id ASC

SELECT u.id AS userId, u.name AS name, u.role AS role, u.asset AS asset, u.is_shared AS assetShared FROM user u WHERE u.id IN (#{groomId}, #{brideId}) ORDER BY CASE WHEN u.id = #{groomId} THEN 0 ELSE 1 END
